how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:priest-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3085:obj:0: Read the Hallowed Tablet and speak to Ken'jai outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3085:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:3085:details:1: BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the priest trainer Ken'jai. He would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3085:completion:0: As ya test yeself, ya'll find ya have better an' better control o'er da spirits--ya'll be callin' on dem fer greata an' greata tings... dat's where ol' Ken'jai come in. You come talk to ole Ken'jai when ya feel yer ready. If da spirits agree, den we see 'bout teachin' ya more powerful abilities... but only if da spirits agree.
rows.quest:3085:completion:1: BGo now, talk to da rest of da Valley's people. Speak to me again later.
rows.quest:3097:obj:0: Read the Hallowed Scroll and speak to Dark Cleric Duesten in the church in Deathknell.
rows.quest:3097:details:0: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the priest trainer Duesten. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
rows.quest:3097:completion:0: There is only one thing you must know: we have survived through will alone. It is faith in ourselves that separates us from others, and with our powers, we will cause great change in all of ⟦E1⟧. The weak will come to lean on you. The lepers will call you Lord. And the ignorant will look to you for guidance. It is my duty to make sure you have the necessary tools so when the time comes, you are prepared. As you grow in experience, seek me out. I will teach you greater powers if you are ready.
rows.quest:3103:obj:0: Read the Hallowed Letter and speak to Priestess Anetta in ⟦E2⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:3103:details:0: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, ⟦2⟧. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Priestess Anetta, our local priest trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
rows.quest:3103:completion:0: As you grow in experience, return to me and I will do what I can to impart my knowledge upon you. Until then, go with compassion in your heart, and let wisdom be your guide. Remember, the world only becomes a better place if you make it so.
rows.quest:3110:obj:0: Read the Hallowed Rune and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.
rows.quest:3110:details:0: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
rows.quest:3110:completion:0: I'm the one who can train ya as you start to find your way around Coldridge Valley. When ya feel yer ready, come back to me and we'll see about maybe teaching you a new spell or two to fend off the valley from them blasted troggs.
rows.quest:3110:completion:1: BYa got the Light on yer side, along with all of ⟦E3⟧, ⟦3⟧... no pressure on ya to become somethin' special.
rows.quest:3119:obj:0: Read the Hallowed Sigil and speak to Shanda in Aldrassil.
rows.quest:3119:details:0: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our priest trainer, Shanda. It seems Shanda would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
rows.quest:3119:completion:0: Do not concern yourself with the world below ⟦E4⟧ for now. There will be time for that later. Go now and speak to the others in ⟦E5⟧--they can tell you more about what events have transpired. Help them in any way you can, and anytime you feel you need more training, come back to me and I will teach you what I can.
rows.quest:5621:obj:0: Find Sentinel Shaya and heal her wounds using ⟦E6⟧ (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Laurna Morninglight in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:5621:details:0: I need your help, ⟦4⟧. I am needed here to train the other students, but you, you can help one of our injured Sentinels just south of Dolanaar. She was hurt patrolling the town and could use our aid. Her name is Shaya.
rows.quest:5621:details:1: BWhen you find her, heal her wounds, and then fortify her body with your spells. This will at least protect her from harm longer if she finds trouble. Return to me here after you've done your duty to ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:5621:completion:0: You have done well and you have served ⟦E7⟧. For that, I thank you.
rows.quest:5621:completion:1: BPlease, take this robe as a token of my thanks. It signifies you have earned your place among our order. If you wish, wear it with pride, but either way, we will always recognize you as one of our own.
rows.quest:5622:details:0: ⟦6⟧, you must travel to Dolanaar when your business here in ⟦E5⟧ is done. There, you will find Laurna Morninglight. She will instruct you further in the ways of ⟦E7⟧, and it is with her that you will earn your first garments denoting your station as a ⟦7⟧ of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:5622:details:1: BTake care, and may you be protected in your journeys.
rows.quest:5622:completion:0: I'm happy to see Shanda has sent you to find me, ⟦8⟧. Teaching young priests the ways of ⟦E7⟧ gives me great satisfaction.
rows.quest:5623:details:0: Hello again, young ⟦9⟧. The time has come for you to learn more about our religion. After you've completed whatever tasks you have here in ⟦E2⟧, please seek out Priestess Josetta in Goldshire. She has more to teach you and has heard that you are growing strong in the ways of the Light. She looks forward to tutoring you more.
rows.quest:5623:completion:0: I'm glad you've arrived, ⟦10⟧. We have much to discuss about your future and your path within the Light.
rows.quest:5624:obj:0: Find Guard Roberts and heal his wounds using ⟦E6⟧ (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.
rows.quest:5624:details:0: Normally I put forth a small challenge to followers of the Light to test their skill. I want to see if they are worthy of wearing their first robes--a sign that the church outwardly approves of the ⟦11⟧ and supports ⟦12⟧.
rows.quest:5624:details:1: BBut this situation is a bit different. One of Goldshire's citizens saw an injured guard near the lake to the east of here. His name is Roberts. Find him, heal him, fortify his body and return here. If you can do that for me, then I will consider your test complete.
rows.quest:5624:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦13⟧. With one more healthy guard out there to help the town, we'll be that much safer. I'm glad to see you're already learning to use your abilities wisely. If you feel you are ready for more training at any time, please come back to me. But for now, take this robe. It will let others know that you are one of our order. If you don't want to wear it, that's fine. Later there will be more tests and this robe isn't necessary for those.
rows.quest:5625:obj:0: Find Mountaineer Dolf and heal his wounds using ⟦E6⟧ (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos.
rows.quest:5625:details:0: It's usually about this time that one of your power is tested to see if they're worthy of wearing robes denoting their place in the church. But to be honest, I got more pressing matters to look into. Citizen of Kharanos' just came in here and told me 'bout a hurt mountaineer just outside town to the south--name's Dolf.
rows.quest:5625:details:1: BYou heal Dolf and give him Fortitude, and I'll consider you done with proving yourself. How's that sound?
rows.quest:5625:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦14⟧. With one more healthy guard out there to help the town, we'll be that much safer. I'm glad to see you're already learning to use your abilities wisely. If you feel you are ready for more training at any time, please come back to me. But for now, take this robe. It will let others know that you are one of our order. If you don't want to wear it, that's fine. Later there will be more tests and this robe isn't necessary for those.
rows.quest:5626:details:1: BYa been following the Light now for long enough that you find your way to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos. He'll teach ya more about the path yer following, and if you prove worthy, give ya yer first set of robes to denote your station as a ⟦16⟧.
rows.quest:5626:details:2: BNow get goin'! As soon as yer done here, head through the tunnel--he'll be waitin' for ya.
rows.quest:5626:completion:0: Oh, so Branstock sent ya, did he? Good, good! He's right, it is 'bout time you started taking a much larger step into the Light. It'll build character and make ya stronger... an' that's what you'll need more than anything: strength of body... strength of will.
rows.quest:5627:completion:0: You've proven yourself worthy of ⟦E7⟧'s attention, ⟦17⟧. If you feel you're ready, I would very much like to teach you one of her spells unique to our people.
rows.quest:5628:details:0: Ah, yes, hello, ⟦18⟧? I'm glad you stopped to talk for a moment. You are a far way from home at such a young age--I admire such ambition. I wish when I was younger I could have mustered the courage to travel the world.
rows.quest:5628:details:1: BThere was a priestess of your order here looking for you not too long ago. She said it was very urgent you returned to the Temple of the Moon in ⟦E10⟧ and speak to Priestess Alathea--it had something to do with your training. I wouldn't dally too long if you can help it.
rows.quest:5628:completion:0: Wonderful, you've returned home, ⟦19⟧. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does ⟦E7⟧ still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.
rows.quest:5629:details:0: Hello again, ⟦20⟧. I know you've been busy aiding our people, but you must take some time for yourself also. Priestess Alathea sent someone here looking for you. It seems that you've caught the attention of our elders and they feel you are prepared for greater things. Head to the Temple of the Moon in ⟦E10⟧ and look for Alathea there. She will be waiting. Good luck, and may ⟦E7⟧ be with you.
rows.quest:5629:completion:0: Wonderful, you've returned home, ⟦21⟧. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does ⟦E7⟧ still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.
rows.quest:5630:details:0: Hello there, ⟦22⟧. Good to see you travelin' far and wide to distant lands. No offense meant, but a lot o' your kind don't take well to these cold climates usually. Glad to see you're made of tougher stuff.
rows.quest:5630:details:1: BNot too long ago one of your priestesses was in here lookin' for you--said somethin' about you finding a Priestess Alathea in the Temple of the Moon back in ⟦E10⟧. Said it was important and you should head back there soon.
rows.quest:5630:completion:0: Wonderful, you've returned home, ⟦23⟧. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does ⟦E7⟧ still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.
rows.quest:5631:details:0: A priestess recently visited our halls seeking you out, young ⟦24⟧. She said that she was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Temple of the Moon in ⟦E10⟧ as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out a Priestess Alathea--she will tell you more.
rows.quest:5631:completion:0: Wonderful, you've returned home, ⟦26⟧. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does ⟦E7⟧ still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.
rows.quest:5632:details:0: Oh, yes, of course. Hello, ⟦27⟧. A messenger from our order was here not too long ago looking for you. She mentioned something important happening back in ⟦E10⟧ and that you should return to the Temple of the Moon as soon as you can. When you arrive, speak to Priestess Alathea. I believe it has something to do with your progressing so well in our ways.
rows.quest:5632:details:1: BAgain, return to ⟦E10⟧ when you can.
rows.quest:5632:completion:0: Wonderful, you've returned home, ⟦28⟧. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does ⟦E7⟧ still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.
rows.quest:5633:details:0: Greetings, ⟦29⟧. Good to see you here in our great halls. A blessing be on you and your kind.
rows.quest:5633:details:1: BWhile you were traveling through our lands, a priestess of your temple came here seeking you. She said that you were to return to the Temple of the Moon as soon as possible. I'm sorry I can't tell you more, but it did sound important. When you get to the temple, speak to a Priestess Alathea.
rows.quest:5633:completion:0: Wonderful, you've returned home, ⟦30⟧. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does ⟦E7⟧ still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.
rows.quest:5634:obj:0: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:5634:details:0: You're needed in ⟦E11⟧, ⟦31⟧. The High Priestess there, Laurena, says it's time for you to prove you're worthy of the next level of your training. Don't waste too much time finding your way there. You can find her in the Cathedral of Light in the center of the city. Give her my regards, and prove how worthy you are of such a calling. The Light be with you, ⟦32⟧.
rows.quest:5634:completion:0: I'm glad you've arrived, ⟦33⟧. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
rows.quest:5634:completion:1: BThere are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.
rows.quest:5635:obj:0: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:5635:details:0: You've caught the attention of our superiors, ⟦34⟧. They've asked you travel to the Cathedral of Light in ⟦E11⟧ as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Laurena. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
rows.quest:5635:completion:0: I'm glad you've arrived, ⟦35⟧. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
rows.quest:5635:completion:1: BThere are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.
rows.quest:5636:obj:0: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:5636:details:0: ⟦E7⟧ bless you, good ⟦36⟧. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.
rows.quest:5636:details:1: BOne of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Cathedral of Light as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Laurena. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
rows.quest:5636:completion:0: I'm glad you've arrived, ⟦37⟧. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
rows.quest:5636:completion:1: BThere are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

rows.quest:5637:details:0: Time's come for you to head to ⟦E11⟧, ⟦38⟧. High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light wants to speak to you. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.
rows.quest:5637:details:1: BBut don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
rows.quest:5637:completion:0: I'm glad you've arrived, ⟦39⟧. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
rows.quest:5637:completion:1: BThere are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

rows.quest:5638:details:0: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, ⟦40⟧. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Cathedral of Light. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.
rows.quest:5638:completion:0: I'm glad you've arrived, ⟦42⟧. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.

rows.quest:5641:obj:0: Speak to High Priest Rohan in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5641:details:0: ⟦46⟧, your High Priest Rohan would have an audience with you in ⟦E3⟧. Make haste, my strong friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Rohan should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. He will be waiting.
rows.quest:5641:completion:0: You've got the makings of a great ⟦47⟧, ⟦48⟧. Keep up the good work!
rows.quest:5641:completion:1: BYou've already shown you're ready for battle. Perhaps it's time we taught ya a little somethin' more.
rows.quest:5642:details:1: BThe normal messengers that come through here looking for troll priests usually are very casual. This time, they seemed to be in much more a hurry. Don't dally too long in ⟦E13⟧. I'd return to the Valley of Spirits as soon as possible.
rows.quest:5642:completion:0: Your rites will come soon enough. For now, I teach you a spell that will be of great use to you when you do battle with your enemies.
rows.quest:5643:details:0: Like many of our own priests, your own tribe puts you through rites of passage. These rites often teach priests special abilities that are vital to their survival. I sense that time is upon you even as we speak. You must return to the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E12⟧ and speak to Ur'kyo. What he teaches you might be very important for the future.
rows.quest:5643:completion:0: Your rites will come soon enough. For now, I teach you a spell that will be of great use to you when you do battle with your enemies.
rows.quest:5644:details:0: Ah, a wonderful day for you, ⟦50⟧. I can see by the lessons you've learned that the time has come to send you back to Aelthalyste. There are things only she can teach you, and even then, only if you prove worthy.
rows.quest:5644:details:1: BI will not spoil the surprise for you, but I remember when I was a young priest learning about true power... divine power. Yes, those were the days.
rows.quest:5644:details:2: BGo back to Aelthalyste in the ⟦E14⟧, ⟦51⟧. She will be awaiting you in the War Quarter.
rows.quest:5644:completion:0: I would teach you ⟦E15⟧ if you feel you are prepared, ⟦52⟧. A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. Practice with it--there will be tests later.
rows.quest:5645:obj:0: Speak to High Priest Rohan in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5645:details:0: ⟦53⟧, your High Priest Rohan would have an audience with you in ⟦E3⟧. Make haste, my strong friend, your next test quickly approaches. Rohan should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. He will be waiting.
rows.quest:5645:completion:0: You've got the makings of a great ⟦54⟧, ⟦55⟧. Keep up the good work!
rows.quest:5645:completion:1: BYou've already shown you're ready for battle. Perhaps it's time we taught ya a little somethin' more.
rows.quest:5646:details:0: Aelthalyste show our people great respect by sending them back to me for more training, and now I do the same for her tribe.
rows.quest:5646:details:1: BYou return to the ⟦E14⟧, ⟦56⟧. There, in the War Quarter, she be ready to teach you more 'bout your people and their ways. Go there, and do not wait long.
rows.quest:5646:completion:0: Good, you've returned, and not a moment too late. We have great things to discuss, ⟦57⟧. Your abilities are growing stronger, and we must make sure you are ready.
rows.quest:5647:obj:0: Speak to High Priest Rohan in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5647:details:0: Your race is so very strong, ⟦58⟧. We are proud to call you allies. And as each day's sun sets, you and your kin grow closer to not only finding your true origins, but find great confidence that you are on the right path in so many things. That feeling must make you feel so triumphant.
rows.quest:5647:details:1: BWord came from ⟦E3⟧ just recently. It asked that you return there and speak to High Priest Rohan in the Mystic Ward. I would not keep him waiting. May ⟦E7⟧ guide your travels.
rows.quest:5647:completion:0: You've got the makings of a great ⟦59⟧, ⟦60⟧. Keep up the good work!
rows.quest:5647:completion:1: BYou've already shown you're ready for battle. Perhaps it's time we taught ya a little somethin' more.
rows.quest:5648:obj:0: Find Grunt Kor'ja and heal her wounds using ⟦E6⟧ (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Tai'jin at Razor Hill.
rows.quest:5648:details:0: You be ready for your first test, ⟦61⟧. South of Razor Hill, just outta town, one of our grunts be hurt fightin' off some o' Proudmoore's old troops. She not doin' too well, an' she benefit much if one of our kind could help her. Find her--her name be Kor'ja--heal her wounds, an' give her the blessin' of our ancestors.
rows.quest:5648:details:1: BYou do this, an' me thinks that be sufficient proof that you ready to move on in our ways.
rows.quest:5648:completion:0: Good, then Kor'ja lives and goes off to defend our town from those malicious humans. I often wish to remember days of battle; where power was shown in combat and it was the wise who often destroyed those who relied on just their strength.
rows.quest:5648:completion:1: BYou done good by me, ⟦62⟧. You take this robe now. Maybe it help, maybe you not care, but you earned it and I'm proud to call you brother.
rows.quest:5649:details:0: Aye, mon. Our kind have joined the ⟦E17⟧ because they be good for us. They loyal, and they teach us much 'bout tings like honor. But our old ways die hard. The orcs may not approve of all our traditions, but that not mean we can't continue to practice some them in secret.
rows.quest:5649:details:1: BYou know this, an' that's why I send you to Tai'jin in Razor Hill. She teach you more 'bout our history. She teach you the ways of our tribe. Go to her when you be ready.
rows.quest:5649:completion:0: Ahh... so you finally come to Tai'jin. This be good.
rows.quest:5649:completion:1: BYou already know that we are not da same tribe that once joined with the ⟦E17⟧. We be much stronger now. We stronger 'cause we adapt--the ⟦E17⟧ teach us that much. We no longer defeat our enemies and gain strength from them; now we gain strength, and then defeat our enemies.
rows.quest:5649:completion:2: BThe difference be subtle, but you will learn. You will see. The tribe count on you to learn such things.
rows.quest:5650:obj:0: Find Deathguard Kel and heal his wounds using ⟦E6⟧ (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Dark Cleric Beryl in ⟦E18⟧.
rows.quest:5650:details:0: Our power comes from darkness and shadow, ⟦63⟧, but that is not your only role. You have acknowledged that there is merit in knowing the healing arts. This is wise. But before you can know the dark, you must also know the light. And for this, I have a test for you.
rows.quest:5650:details:1: BNorth of the cemetery is a wounded Deathguard--Deathguard Kel. He has protected us from gnolls for some time, and needs healing. But, you must also fortify his body before he can return to duty. Do both with your spells, and then return to me.
rows.quest:5650:completion:0: You have passed my test with ease. Good.
rows.quest:5650:completion:1: BSoon, you will be ready to take on more responsibility and that road will lead to darker powers--powers that no ⟦64⟧ of another race has.
rows.quest:5650:completion:2: BTake this robe as a symbol of your station. You have earned it. If you do not wish to wear it, then so be it, you may do with it as you will. I and others like us will always acknowledge you for what you've achieved in our ranks.
rows.quest:5651:obj:0: Speak to Dark Cleric Beryl in ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:5651:details:0: There are many lessons that the ⟦E20⟧ have learned through experience--things that some races can only begin to fathom. And although our path lies in darkness, you will find that a great many things rely on both the light and the dark. Your lessons shall teach you to use both... and with discretion. But heed my words: never forget we were forged in corruption and left to rot like so much carrion. The Darkness is our home.
rows.quest:5651:details:1: BSeek out Dark Cleric Beryl in ⟦E18⟧ when you're ready to learn more.
rows.quest:5651:completion:0: Finally, you've arrived. Your faith alone will not allow you to pass the trials before you, young one. A sense of urgency and some ambition will help too.
rows.quest:5652:details:0: I sent here to make sure that you not wander too far from home, ⟦65⟧. They send me to make sure you return home because Ur'kyo, greatest of our priests, wish to speak to you. You go there. You got to the Valley of Spirits in the orc city and you speak to Ur'kyo. He wait for you now.
rows.quest:5652:completion:0: You would do well to pay heed to this lesson, young one. The Hex of Weakness will be a great boon to you in battle. Later I will have tests for you to further yourself and prove your worth to the tribe.
rows.quest:5654:details:0: It be time for you to meet with Ur'kyo, ⟦66⟧. He be in the Valley of Spirits in the orc city. Go there and speak to him. It is time you learn more of the old ways of our kind. It time you be brought into the circle and made a true priest of our tribe.
rows.quest:5654:completion:0: You would do well to pay heed to this lesson, young one. The Hex of Weakness will be a great boon to you in battle. Later I will have tests for you to further yourself and prove your worth to the tribe.

He wait for you now.
rows.quest:5655:completion:0: You would do well to pay heed to this lesson, young one. The Hex of Weakness will be a great boon to you in battle. Later I will have tests for you to further yourself and prove your worth to the tribe.
rows.quest:5656:details:0: It always warms my undying heart to see priests from all cultures wander the world. To know that power exists that is not arcane and well within our grasp. That's why it is my honor to direct you home, ⟦68⟧.
rows.quest:5656:details:1: BUr'kyo, your great priest in ⟦E12⟧, has asked for your presence. You can find him in the Valley of Spirits.
rows.quest:5656:completion:0: You would do well to pay heed to this lesson, young one. The Hex of Weakness will be a great boon to you in battle. Later I will have tests for you to further yourself and prove your worth to the tribe.
rows.quest:5657:details:1: BYour spiritual leader Ur'kyo begs you to return to him and speak about the path you travel.
rows.quest:5657:details:2: BGo to the Valley of Spirits in the great ⟦E17⟧ city of ⟦E12⟧. You will find him there.
